description.zh: 分页查询时每页的最大条目数。最大值为 100。默认值为 20。
description.en: The maximum number of results to return. The maximum value is 100. The default value is 20.

description.zh:
分页游标。
> 不为空表示有更多数据。
description.en:
The pagination cursor.

> A non-empty value indicates that more data is available.
The number of results to skip.

descriptions.zh: 该接口查询的是公开信息，不涉及账号特殊归属等信息，故不支持授权。
descriptions.en: This API is used to query public information, so authorization is not required.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun openapiexplorer list-api-mcp-server-cores --id v6ZZ7ftCzEILW000 --next-token AAAAAZjtYxxxxxxxx --max-results 10 --skip 5 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun openapiexplorer GET /apimcpservercores --region cn-hangzhou --nextToken AAAAAZjtYxxxxxxxx --maxResults 10 --skip 5 --id v6ZZ7ftCzEILW000 --header "Content-Type=application/json"
